title: Preliminary Evaluation of Screening for Pancreatic Cancer in Patients With Inherited Genetic Risk
official: Preliminary Evaluation of Screening for Pancreatic Cancer in Patients With Inherited Genetic Risk
summary: The study is a prospective, observational study evaluating the utility of endoscopic ultrasound or MRI for the identification of preneoplastic and neoplastic pancreatic lesions in patients at high risk for pancreatic cancer, specifically those with BRCA1/2, ATM, or PALB2 mutations.

interventions.name: Collection of data from endoscopic ultrasound or MRI/MRCP of the abdomen

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Age \>= 18
* Documented germline pathogenic or likely pathogenic BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, or PALB2 mutation
* If no history of PDAC in a first or second degree relative, age \>= 50
* If there is a history of PDAC in a first or second degree relative, minimum age of eligibility is 10 years younger than the age of onset of the youngest relative with pancreatic cancer

Exclusion Criteria

• Pregnancy
sponsor: Abramson Cancer Center at Penn Medicine
